title: Korean-Style Songpyeon Udon Noodles
description: A unique fusion recipe combining the textures of warm, flaky songpyeon with udon noodles in a traditional Korean-inspired dish.
instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat sesame oil in a pan over medium heat.
Pan-fry the warm, flaky songpyeon until crispy and golden brown. Set aside.
In the same pan, add Korean chili flakes and stir for 1 minute.
Add cooked udon noodles to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Season with soy sauce and toss to coat.
Add pan-fried songpyeon on top of the noodles and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds (if using).
